title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the post-persistence mutation fan-out out of protocol.ts into protocol-mutation-fan-out.ts (#25467 cut 25)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 25 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–24 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317, #26350, #26366, #26404, #26449, #26654 and #26704. The claim is `6446194706`. It takes the cut 25 proposal of the cut 24 report (`6443136164`), a themed group. All four members passed the AST screen and the read-seam census, and all four moved unedited.

Four `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into one new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-mutation-fan-out.ts` (#23050 shape B). Together they are the post-persistence mutation fan-out:

- `runMutationProjector`: the registered projector for a just-persisted mutation (ADR-0094). It is awaited and never throws.
- `notifyMutationListenersLocal`: the local half of `emitMetadataMutation` (#2588, #13331). Each listener is isolated.
- `publishMetadataMutation`: the cluster half of `emitMetadataMutation` (#13331). It publishes the mutation's address to peers, fire-and-forget, and skips drafts.
- `emitMetaItemPublished`: the per-item publish listeners (#10219), awaited and isolated.

`protocol.ts` loses 25 net lines (29,152 to 29,127). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `0f3d068cf1` (after cut 24's merge). It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `62c90d6199` and one merge of `main`, `02bc68c682` (13 commits). The merge touches no file of `packages/metadata-protocol/`. The package's `src/` tree is `91361684` at the move commit and at the merge.

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

Measured just before this PR was opened, against the merged head `02bc68c682`: of the 26 open PRs, **none edits `protocol.ts`**, and none names any of the four members, `MutationFanOutHost` or the new module. Four touch other files of `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`:

- **#26769**: one test file.
- **#26782**: nine `migrations/` files.
- **#26786**: one test file.
- **#26799**: one test file.

Each one's `git merge-tree` is clean against this head.

`main` moved three commits after the merge: #26787, #26788 (dogfood tests) and #26796 (`create-objectstack`). None touches this package, `git merge-tree` with this head is clean, and the derivation found nothing stale, so `main` was not merged again.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`, the read-seam census, the call-site counts)

All four members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** No body has `new Error(`, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed.
- **Read-seam census.** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` was taken on the base and again on the cut. Both read `88 read seam(s)`; the base count has grown from 82 since cut 24, through `main`. The lists are identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped. The full readings are under "The durability `--list`".
- **The recovery-doors call-site counts hold.** `protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation.test.ts` and `protocol.recovery-doors-mutation-projector.test.ts` read `protocol.ts` by path and count its text. The counts at base and head:

| Pattern counted in `protocol.ts` | Base | Head |
|---|---|---|
| `this.emitMetadataMutation(` | 7 | 7 |
| `private emitMetadataMutation(` | 1 | 1 |
| `this.notifyMutationListenersLocal(` | 2 | 2 |
| `private notifyMutationListenersLocal(` | 1 | 1 |
| `this.runMutationProjector(` | 7 | 7 |
| `private async runMutationProjector(` | 1 | 1 |

  The callers that are counted stay in the class: `emitMetadataMutation` (local, then cluster), `applyRemoteMetadataMutation` (local only), the seven projecting doors and the per-item publish door. That test file also slices `applyRemoteMetadataMutation`'s body by text, and that body does not move. Both files pass at both ends, in the package suite.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) | Reads |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `runMutationProjector` | `:7493` | private async | 12 | 113 | `mutationProjectors` (field) |
| `notifyMutationListenersLocal` | `:7563` | private | 10 | 66 | `metadataMutationListeners` (field) |
| `publishMetadataMutation` | `:7675` | private | 16 | 115 | `clusterPubSub`, `clusterNodeId` (fields) |
| `emitMetaItemPublished` | `:7864` | private async | 15 | 80 | `metaItemPublishedListeners` (field) |

`protocol-mutation-fan-out.ts` has 152 lines.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–24 apply it)

- **The class keeps all four members.** Each keeps its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 25]`.
- **Every member read is a field, so each is handed over as a getter.** `MutationFanOutHost` types each field as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['…']`). Each function types its `this` as the `Pick` of what it reads, and each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType<typeof …>`.
  - The getters read the protocol's own listener arrays, projector map and cluster wiring at call time.
  - `attachMetadataMutationPubSub`/`detachMetadataMutationPubSub` reassign `clusterPubSub` and `clusterNodeId`, and the getter sees the current values, exactly as the body did. This is the field hand-over cuts 20, 23 and 24 used.
  - No body reassigns a field; the listener arrays and the projector map are only iterated or read.
- **None of the four reads another**, so no closure is owed.
- **No member changes visibility.**
- **Every caller still calls the class method.** The sites (base) are:
  - `this.runMutationProjector(` at `:21364`, `:22976`, `:26599`, `:26718`, `:27073`, `:27923` and `:28121`.
  - `this.notifyMutationListenersLocal(` at `:7550` and `:7787`.
  - `this.publishMetadataMutation(` at `:7551`.
  - `this.emitMetaItemPublished(` at `:22394`.

  None of them changes.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

Measured by an AST walk over each body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded):

| Name | Where `protocol.ts` has it | Other readers in `protocol.ts` | What this cut does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `METADATA_MUTATION_CLUSTER_CHANNEL` | exported `const`, `:5926` | yes (`attachMetadataMutationPubSub`, and docblocks) | none (already exported); the new module imports it from `./protocol.js` |
| `ClusterMetadataMutationPayload` | exported interface | yes (`attachMetadataMutationPubSub`) | none; imported as a type |
| `MetadataMutationEvent`, `MutationProjectionOutcome`, `MetaItemPublishedEvent` | exported interfaces | yes (the stubs' declared signatures and others) | none; imported as types |

No import of `protocol.ts` loses its last reader, and no declaration gains `export`.

## The published `.d.ts`: one emitter trap, met and avoided

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **Both hold for this cut, as pushed.**

**Disclosed: the first layout of this cut failed the bar, and only through comments.** The cut's first import comment was 16 characters longer. With it, the head `.d.ts` moved to `0105198c6b324117…` (782,358 bytes; normalised `c211e183dfe9c5e8…`). The diff against base was one hunk: an inferred type from `@objectstack/spec` printed as `generatedBy /** … */ ? /** … */ : string | undefined` instead of `generatedBy?: string | undefined;`. Both comments were `protocol.ts`'s own `:967` docblock ("Zod schemas used to validate overlay items…"), which has nothing to do with that type.

- The two files print identically with comments stripped (TypeScript printer, `removeComments`; sha `99dc518ed3a640f9…` for both). So no type moved.
- The mechanism, as measured: tsc's declaration emitter reuses a node whose source is another file, but reads its comment ranges from `protocol.ts`'s text at the same offset. The cut's added import comment had shifted that docblock to start at exactly that offset (50,150).
- Shortening the cut's own import comment by 16 characters moved the docblock off that offset, and raw identity returned (below). The bundles' JS does not change with comment text (`index.js` `8ef90e4aa9cbf4b4…` both ways).
- The trap is latent on `main`: any edit that moves the docblock onto that offset would trigger it. Diff the `.d.ts` hunk before blaming a change for it.

Base `0f3d068cf1` and head `62c90d6199` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (116/116). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `310d157f1455a7b76c3d9a60e905ac5e07debb23ec4a6a615b510870341bdbec` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs. **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: `724eaa784128c37a7e4b59d85e21212ba6378a5b07279853c97828cd8368e932` at both ends, 777,143 bytes. **Raw identity holds.** It is also the hash cut 24 measured, since the base is cut 24's merge.
- **Again on the merged tree** `02bc68c682` (closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 116/116): the same raw and normalised sha256, and the same `index.js`/`index.cjs` hashes, as the pre-merge head.
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `0cb9bc1754636851…` at base and `8ef90e4aa9cbf4b4…` at head (`index.cjs` `40c568bf03d0672b…` → `65ffd5926831fb5d…`).
  - Each of the four `….call(host` spellings occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
  - Each `function …(` declaration goes 0 → 1.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `runMutationProjector` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `c996c4705a6c30f8…` (normalised `5db8ebd53a1498a3…`, which differs from the bar's `310d157f…`). So the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. None of the four functions, and not `MutationFanOutHost`, appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output: `88 read seam(s)` at both ends. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (164 lines, and no entry changes file).

- Three of the bodies have a `try` (`runMutationProjector`, and the two listener loops). Each guards a callback, not a call in the gate's read vocabulary (`find`/`findOne`/`count`).
- Each catch logs at `warn`, as before. No seam enters or leaves the census.
- On the merged tree the verdict still reads `88 read seam(s)`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `0f3d068cf1` against the head module:

```
runMutationProjector: base tokens 113, head tokens 113, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
notifyMutationListenersLocal: base tokens 66, head tokens 66, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
publishMetadataMutation: base tokens 115, head tokens 115, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
emitMetaItemPublished: base tokens 80, head tokens 80, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=374 differ=0 members=4
CLASS members base=301 head=301 order-same=true byte-identical=297 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=4 other=[]
TOP base=254 head=255 byte-identical=254
```

**Negative controls**, one per member. Each changed one token in an in-memory copy of the head module, and only the mutated member moved (differ 1; the other three stayed 0):

```
"return { success: true };"            -> "return { success: false };"            runMutationProjector differ 1
"listener(evt);"                        -> "listener(e);"                          notifyMutationListenersLocal differ 1
"if (evt.state === 'draft') return;"   -> "if (evt.state !== 'draft') return;"   publishMetadataMutation differ 1
"await listener(evt);"                  -> "void listener(evt);"                   emitMetaItemPublished differ 1
```

- **Class side.** There are 301 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 297 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. All four stubs sit at their base positions and keep their docblocks and signatures byte-identical.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** All 254 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +179 / −52 over 2 files, 231 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 200–260).

## Readers of the moved lines

The tests and scripts that read `protocol.ts` by path were grepped for the four member names, the fields they read, and the bodies' log text: `mutation projector failed`, `metadata-mutation listener failed`, `cluster metadata-mutation publish failed`, `post-publish re-bind announce FAILED`, `partitionKey`. These are the files that name `protocol.ts` and call `readFileSync`. So were the test files in `packages/`, `docs/qa/` and the `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers.

- **By path, two readers name the members, and neither reads a moved body.** They are the two recovery-doors tests above. They count call sites and declarations, which stay, and their table holds at both ends. The emit-mutation test also names `publishMetadataMutation` in a comment.
- **Behaviour through the class method, no edit owed.** These drive the four members through the protocol:
  - `protocol.cluster-mutation-fanout.test.ts`, `mutation-listeners.test.ts` and both recovery-doors tests (metadata-protocol).
  - `plugin-publish-announce.test.ts`, `plugin-authored-hooks.test.ts` and `plugin-authored-actions.test.ts` (objectql).

  The metadata-protocol ones pass at both ends, in the package suite.
- **The liveness ledgers.** No row points at any of the four. Carried forward: `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19), and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). `check:liveness` checks only that the `#symbol` is named in the file. Re-pointing them is a `packages/spec/**` edit, outside this card.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends.
  - The decision-letter count is unchanged at 1,898. No moved body cites an ADR letter.
  - The citation count goes 59,968 → 59,969 and the file count 8,393 → 8,394, from the new module's header (ADR-0094).
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13863 → 13838, 13888 → 13863).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,798 at base and 3,800 at head. The +2 are the new file and the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree, as in cuts 20–24.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `0f3d068cf1`.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 at head and on the merged tree.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output (the whole touched package, with the root `lint` script's flags).
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status. Each leg ran vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock.
  - Base `0f3d068cf1`: 21,635 tests (21,616 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 272 files.
  - Head `62c90d6199`: 21,635 tests (21,616 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 272 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `0f3d068cf1` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
  - The merged head `02bc68c682` gives the same 21,635 tests, per test identical to the pre-merge head (0 lost, 0 added, 0 changed).
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK. 1 anchored file is in the change set, 29 anchors were judged, and 0 were lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register (13 surfaces), so the PR is NOT governed. It has 231 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 gates on 2 changed paths from `02bc68c682`, with no stale-tree finding. All 46 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (116/116). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN, and exits 0.
- `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` on `02bc68c682`: `88 read seam(s)`.

## Carry-forward

These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- **The read-seam members** (cut 21). A member named in a `protocol.ts` read-seam entry of `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list`, as the guarded wrapper or the guarding member, stays until the gate follows imported wrappers or a ruling accepts the loss.
  - This is the census-negative set that cuts 22–23 measured: `findEnvironmentRows`, `packagelessAddress`, `findServedOverlayRow`, `foldStoredCollection`, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `unmanagedImportCollisions`, `rollBackUnmanagedImport`, `readRevertableCommit` and `storedFlowBindingAgrees`.
  - `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` cannot move at all.
  - This cut re-trialled only its own members and the cut 26 candidates.
- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- **The bodies kept by a by-path reader:**
  - `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType` and `metaTypeNamespaceExists`.
  - `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, and `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`.
  - The 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers (among them `applyRemoteMetadataMutation`), `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
  - `emitMetadataMutation`, a counted call site.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable` and `resolveSduiManifest`.
